_about: The openssl of the personas (tpot_personas.system.openssl_data): per build of a release level its family and the size of /usr/bin/openssl and the lines of `version -a` with the option that prints each alone (CPUINFO: null, the CPU of the persona decides it); per family the style of its option parsing and its texts (help, help -help, version -help, list -commands; OpenSSL 1.0.2: the listing of its error for an unknown command). Recorded with the real openssl of each build in a container of its release (amd64; Raspberry Pi OS arm64; the EdgeOS and NAS326 programs from their firmware images under qemu-user); list -commands and help -help in containers of the release images (tests/fixtures/openssl_refs.json has the recordings). Derived: list -commands and help -help of the EdgeOS families are those of debian:9 (1.1.0l) and debian:10 (1.1.1n), help -help of the Red Hat families that of the other OpenSSL 3 builds (unverified).
